title: Who ends with more marbles, Jia or Ruhee?
description: Two sums are compared without working out either total, by imagining two children who each get more marbles. Keeko doubts the answer and thinks the first sum must be greater because it starts higher.
teaching_notes: One idea: compare two sums by how much each number changes, not by their totals. Watch for children who pick the sum that starts with the bigger number.

video_script.why: The child compares two sums by thinking about how much each number differs.
video_script.substitution: Imagine two children who each get more marbles, and compare the start and the gain.
video_script.anchor: Jia and Ruhee with their marbles, before and after today
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko picks the sum that starts with the bigger number and ignores that Ruhee gets three more marbles today.
video_script.payoff_line: Ruhee ends with two more marbles than Jia

final_answer.spoken: one thousand twenty three plus one hundred twenty five is less than one thousand twenty two plus one hundred twenty eight, and the second is greater by two

names.Jia: the child who had 1023 marbles and got 125 more
names.Ruhee: the child who had 1022 marbles and got 128 more

maths_rules: Jia has 1023 marbles and gets 125 more.
Ruhee has 1022 marbles and gets 128 more.
video_script.design: One idea: compare sums by the changes in the numbers. Assumes taking away to find a difference. Wrong idea: the sum that starts higher is greater. The two children and their marbles stay all video.

beats.on_screen: To find: who ends with more marbles

marks.find: the words who ends with more marbles are written

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find who ends with more marbles, without working out either total.

marks.start: the two starting numbers are compared and the difference 1 is written

narration: <bookmark mark='start'/>Step one, compare the start. Jia has one thousand twenty three and Ruhee has one thousand twenty two. Jia starts with one more.

marks.gain: the two gains 125 and 128 are compared

narration: <bookmark mark='gain'/>Step two, compare what each gets today. Ruhee gets one hundred twenty eight and Jia gets one hundred twenty five.
<bookmark mark='diff'/>One hundred twenty eight minus one hundred twenty five is three, so Ruhee gets three more.

marks.net: the gain 3 and the start 1 are set against each other and the result 2 is written

narration: <bookmark mark='net'/>Step three, put the two together. Ruhee gets three more but starts with one less, so three minus one leaves two more.
<bookmark mark='ans'/>Ruhee ends with two more marbles than Jia. The second sum is the greater one.
<bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: Keeko's bubble shows: the first sum is greater, because it starts with 1023; beside it, Ruhee gets 3 more and starts only 1 behind; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

marks.fix: the extra 3 and the extra 1 appear and the bubble is struck through

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks the first sum is greater, because it starts with the bigger number.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>But Ruhee gets three more today and starts only one behind. The extra three is more than the extra one.
